rule: External prerequisites may be marked PASS only with concrete evidence. Missing provider, legal, support, domain or credential evidence keeps public release blocked.

billing_provider_approved.note: KCA-09/09B are provider-neutral and sandbox-certified; no approved production SaaS billing provider is recorded in the canonical Kordena sources.

transactional_email.note: Public signup has a VerificationDispatcher boundary, but no approved production transactional-email provider/runtime composition is recorded.

terms_policies.note: Signup records acceptance, but approval/publication evidence for applicable commercial terms/privacy policies is not recorded in this repository.

support_readiness.note: No final customer-support operating evidence is recorded for KCA-17.

final_domain_dns_tls.note: Domain ownership is known externally, but DNS/TLS/application binding must be verified before public activation.

public_release_authorization.note: Public trial remains disabled until all KCA-17 prerequisites pass and the Director authorizes rollout. Visual Premium remains outside this functional mission.
